run_grpc_compression_server: run a gRPC server with gzip or deflate compression on a specified port
run_server_with_no_compression: run the gRPC server with no compression using the default settings
run_server_selective_compression: run the gRPC server that skips compression on every nth response
review_Greeter_SayHello: review the Greeter class SayHello method that returns a HelloReply with optional compression suppression
review_Greeter_should_suppress_compressi: review the Greeter _should_suppress_compression method that uses a thread-safe counter to decide compression
